lessons.title: 1 · First sound
lessons.description: Add modules, patch cables, hear and see an oscillator.

lessons.title: 2 · Filter and envelope
lessons.description: Shape a sound: filter, gates and the ADSR envelope.

lessons.title: 3 · Modulation
lessons.description: Let an LFO turn the knobs: CV, vibrato and trills.

lessons.title: 4 · Sequences and melody
lessons.description: Clock, sequencer and quantizer: from one tone to a melody.

lessons.title: 5 · Drums and rhythm
lessons.description: Euclidean rhythms, drum triggers, logic and swing.

lessons.title: 6 · Effects and mix
lessons.description: Mixer, delay, chorus and reverb: give the sound a space.
